name: Lethe
description: Persistent memory layer for AI agents — the antidote to the river Lethe.

apiKey.description: API key for Lethe server authentication (optional)

agentId.description: Agent identifier used when creating sessions

autoLog.description: When enabled, sends user and assistant message text and serialized tool-result content to the configured Lethe server as persistent log events, in addition to tool-call and open-thread markers. Disabled by default; real turns still write checkpoints with extracted thread and last-tool metadata.

memoryGitContext.description: Opt in to the experimental Memory Git context adapter. Charon is the default owner of versioned memory.
